description: This file contains unit tests for handling invalid connection preambles in Orleans gateway endpoints, specifically testing that the connection is closed when an invalid preamble size is sent by the client.

classes.name: InvalidPreambleConnectionTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying the server's behavior when receiving invalid connection preambles, ensuring the connection is closed appropriately.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Overrides the test cluster configuration to set the connection transport type to TCP socket.

methods.name: ShouldCloseConnectionWhenClientSendsInvalidPreambleSize
methods.description: Test method that sends an invalid preamble size to the gateway and asserts that the connection is closed.
